name: Soft
idea: Cream and one deep colour, rounded cards and pill labels, friendly type: a warm consumer-brand deck.
brief: A warm consumer brand's investor deck (owner's references, 2026-10-09). Slides alternate between a pale cream ground and a deep, dark field of the deck's colour. Corners are soft (var(--radius) on every card and image). Each slide names its section in a small pill tag at the top left, and carries the deck's name and the page in a pill at the top right. Headlines in a friendly grotesk, sentence case, large and tight. Numbers live in rounded cards on a soft surface, never in a row of equal ones: one large card and smaller ones, or a figure with a thin rounded progress bar. The product appears on a phone (a drawn visual) leaning into the slide. A giant soft brand motif (the deck's own letter, a single fat curved line, a circle) crops off one edge at low contrast behind the content. Comparisons are a clean grid with the product's column on its own rounded surface. Generous padding, nothing cramped.
never: more than two colours besides cream and the deep field

styles: friendly flat illustration with rounded shapes and soft natural colours
warm editorial illustration, simple rounded forms, calm and human
